description: This file implements a custom logging system for the Kivy framework, extending Python's standard logging module with additional features such as color-coded output, log history, custom handlers, and environment-based configuration. It defines classes for handling log files, console output, log record formatting, and environment detection, and manages the setup of logging modes (KIVY, PYTHON, MIXED).

classes.name: FileHandler
classes.description: Custom logging handler for writing logs to files with log rotation and purge capabilities.

classes.name: LoggerHistory
classes.description: Logging handler that keeps a history of recent log records.

classes.name: ConsoleHandler
classes.description: Stream handler that outputs logs to stderr, with special handling for messages starting with 'stderr:'.

classes.name: ProcessingStream
classes.description: Stream-like object that prefixes lines and applies a callback function.

classes.name: ColonSplittingLogRecord
classes.description: Custom log record that formats messages containing colons for categorization.

classes.name: ColoredLogRecord
classes.description: Log record that adds terminal color codes based on log level.

classes.name: UncoloredLogRecord
classes.description: Log record that strips color and formatting markup from messages.

classes.name: KivyFormatter
classes.description: Formatter that splits message fields and applies color coding if enabled.

methods.name: add_kivy_handlers
methods.description: Adds Kivy-specific logging handlers to a given logger.

methods.name: logger_config_update
methods.description: Updates logger configuration based on environment variables.
